name: Deran
desc:
Deran is a Khan NPC found within [The Chariot's Spire](location:the_chariots_spire), who may grant you access to the Deepdriller. This spawns you at [The Frontier Furnace](location:the_frontier_furnace) and does not require you to kill the Bone Keeper.

He will only grant you access if you are an Ignition Delver and have escaped the [Second Layer](location:second_layer) using the Deepdriller once prior. Otherwise, he will deny your request.
